propositions: Cloud transport mutations lack per-member 429 enumeration across all seams (ACLI subprocess, pooled direct REST, bare urlopen) and dispatch levels (retrying wrapper, non-retrying apply phases, no wrapper), causing potential undetected retry paths that could issue duplicate writes
Cloud does not validate HTTP scheme in base URL and does not fail loudly on missing credentials, unlike DC (bug cd78 shape), creating silent degradation risks
Cloud probe hardcodes RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES without runtime configuration, blocking parity with DC's configurable resolved-status set for non-standard workflow names
DC exposes no user-search method aliases and degrades to string matching; Cloud behavior under that constraint is unasserted

429 sweep test coverage is split across four distinct retry boundaries (direct REST, bare urlopen, subprocess backoff, dispatch wrapper) with different intended behaviors; incomplete instrumentation at any boundary masks latent duplicate-write mutations
